arms.clean_dpo: Use generated preference labels as sampled.
arms.flip_20pct: Independently flip each training preference label with probability 0.20.
arms.shuffle_labels: Shuffle the training preference labels with a separate deterministic RNG seeded by seed+100000.

artifact_policy: Retain protocol snapshot, source hash, all generated train and held-out examples, seed-level metrics, aggregate summary, run environment, and SHA-256 manifest. Never discard a failed run. Development data and confirmation data are stored in separate bundles; the development runner must not generate held-out data.
claim_boundary: Synthetic mechanism evidence only; not language-model training, reasoning, truthfulness, alignment, or capability evidence.

development.selection_evidence: An exploratory training-only sweep on seeds 211,223,227,229,233,239,241,251,257,263 inspected candidate budgets 25,50,75,100,125,150,175,200. It did not generate or inspect held-out outcomes. The separate development cohort below replays a predeclared selection rule.
development.selection_rule: Choose the largest candidate update count for which mean training-context KL to the uniform reference is <=0.45 and every development seed has training-context KL <=0.50. Compute metrics only on the examples used to update that seed policy. No held-out contexts or labels are generated in development.

generator.contexts: 8 independent standard-normal features from Python random.Random(seed).gauss(0, 1), generated in the declared order.
generator.heldout_split: 128 subsequently generated independent contexts, 2 comparisons per context (256 pairs); never used for updates or model selection.
generator.preference: For a sampled unordered action pair (a,b), label a preferred with probability sigmoid(u(x,a)-u(x,b)); sample a Bernoulli draw using the same per-seed RNG stream.
generator.train_split: 64 independently generated contexts, 8 comparisons per context (512 pairs).

gradient_check.method: central finite differences on a fixed four-action, eight-feature preference minibatch and fixed nonzero parameter vector.

learner.objective: Mean softplus(-beta * ((log pi(chosen|x)-log pi(rejected|x)) - (log pi_ref(chosen|x)-log pi_ref(rejected|x)))); beta=1.0 and pi_ref is frozen uniform.
learner.optimizer: Full-batch gradient descent, learning_rate=0.2, updates=100; budget selected using training-only development diagnostics before confirmation outcomes were generated.
learner.policy: Contextual categorical policy pi(a|x)=softmax(theta[a] dot x), initialized with all theta=0.

metrics.primary: mean held-out pairwise preference NLL difference clean_dpo minus reference; lower is better.
secondary: mean policy KL(pi||uniform) over held-out contexts
teacher expected utility over held-out contexts

purpose: Confirm a training-budget choice on an independent synthetic preference seed cohort after a separately labeled training-only development phase.
